items.t: Starter relay can corrode and catch fire (recall)
Starter can overheat from internal wear (recall)
Transmission can lose drive from an oil leak into its computer (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission control (mechatronics) unit and fluid

items.t: Brake assist can drop out during engine start (recall)
Driver seat belt mount may be poorly welded (recall)
items.job: Inspect seat belt guide loop mount

items.t: Passenger seat belt may not lock properly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace passenger seat belt retractor

items.t: One or both headlights can stop working (recall)
Headlight aim can be moved sideways (recall)
Backup camera picture can stay hidden (recall)
Load capacity label may show wrong numbers (recall)
Loud buffeting with the windows down
items.job: Install aftermarket anti-buffeting wind deflector kit
items.note: Most owners install the kit themselves.

items.t: Weak battery warning or no start after sitting
items.job: Test and replace the 12V AGM battery and register it to the car
items.note: No parts-plus-labor source found, so this is based on YourMechanic totals for 2020–2023 GR Supra battery replacement: $671–$755 estimate, $804–$1,361 at shops and dealers. Have the battery tested and charged first: if it tests good, a software update or charge may fix it for much less.

items.t: Seat noise when sliding forward or back
items.job: Remove seat and lubricate seat motor drive shafts (bulletin T-SB-0006-20)
items.note: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0006-20 lists 1.0 hour for one seat and 0.5 hour more for the other side; the only material is a small bottle of light oil.

items.t: Steering wheel shake at highway speed
items.job: Four-wheel alignment and wheel balance check
items.note: A Toyota dealer lists about 60-90 minutes for a GR Supra four-wheel alignment. YourMechanic: $95-$132 for a vibration inspection alone. A bent wheel or worn tire costs extra.
